full_name: Daphne A. Brooks | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Daphne A. Brooks is a professor of English and African American studies at Princeton University, where her research focuses on 19th- and 20th-century African American literary and cultural production, performance studies, black feminist theory, and popular music studies.
